name: boldr-max
description: Construction jobsite data in ChatGPT: browse projects and jobs, record measurements, fill forms, import CSVs, upload photos and plans, annotate drawings, print QR labels, and run construction calculators.

interface.longDescription:
BOLDR MAX organizes your construction projects' measurements, photos, and videos seamlessly.

BOLDR Pro is REEKON Tools' jobsite data platform for construction teams: projects, jobs, and field measurements captured by REEKON measuring devices or entered manually, organized into forms with per-column tolerances.

This plugin gives ChatGPT full read and write access to your organization — governed by your existing BOLDR role and shares, so connecting never grants more than you already have in the apps.

Read & analyze: browse projects, jobs, and forms; list measurements in any unit; find out-of-tolerance values using BOLDR's own tolerance math; track progress and deviation trends; search files by name across the whole organization; export complete job tables as CSV.

Write: create projects, jobs, and forms; record measurements (plain-language values like 3' 4-1/2" work); bulk-create up to 50 rows at once or import a whole table from CSV-like data in one call; upload photos and PDFs; annotate photos and plans with strokes, shapes, and live measurement tiles; save printable labels whose QR codes deep-link into the apps; import construction calculators pre-filled with your inputs; move jobs and folders between projects.

Destructive operations are clearly marked so the assistant confirms before deleting. Read-only connections see only the read tools. Documentation: https://api.boldrpro.com/mcp-docs
